# Test queries

### Happy Path

Existing CPH

[http://localhost:8085/animals?species=cattle&siteIdentifier=12/345/6789](http://localhost:8085/animals?species=cattle&siteIdentifier=12/345/6789)

Holding with no cattle  
[http://localhost:8085/animals?species=cattle&siteIdentifier=23/456/7890](http://localhost:8085/animals?species=cattle&siteIdentifier=23/456/7890)

### Paging, ordering and sorting

[http://localhost:8085/animals?species=cattle&siteIdentifier=12/345/6789&page=1&pageSize=2](http://localhost:8085/animals?species=cattle&siteIdentifier=12/345/6789&page=1&pageSize=2)  
[http://localhost:8085/animals?species=cattle&siteIdentifier=12/345/6789&order=state&sort=desc](http://localhost:8085/animals?species=cattle&siteIdentifier=12/345/6789&order=state&sort=desc)  
[http://localhost:8085/animals?species=cattle&siteIdentifier=12/345/6789&order=animalIdentifier&sort=asc](http://localhost:8085/animals?species=cattle&siteIdentifier=12/345/6789&order=animalIdentifier&sort=asc)

### Non-cattle species

[http://localhost:8085/animals?species=sheep&siteIdentifier=12/345/6789](http://localhost:8085/animals?species=pigs&siteIdentifier=12/345/6789)
